answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation with slashing: an agent must lock tokens against its registered address, and peers attest its work like a reef where every coral polyp's contribution is visible. A whisper of fake activity earns nothing without stake behind it, while honest agents compound trust and draw the nectar of fees. If clones are caught, the stake is slashed and paid to victims, so running a sybil swarm costs more than it earns.
